01 — The idea

Not menswear. Not womenswear. Motionwear.

ASCENSION is a clothing system for people who refuse one version of themselves. Each numbered piece transforms in silhouette, utility and mood—designed beyond gender and beyond seasons.

02 — The State System

One garment.
Three lives.

Built-in shifts let you move from clean structure to loose volume without changing who gets to wear it.

01

Structured

Full shell. High collar. Quiet protection for the outside world.

02

Released

Detach the lower panel. Cropped proportion, lighter movement.

03

Carried

Fold, strap and wear cross-body. The garment becomes its own object.
